title: Age and next birthday
description:
Write `class Birthdays` with two methods that take today's date as a parameter (so they are testable):

- `static int age(LocalDate born, LocalDate today)`: whole years.
- `static long daysUntilNextBirthday(LocalDate born, LocalDate today)`: 0 if today is the birthday. Someone born on 29 February celebrates on 28 February in years that are not leap years.
hints: `Period.between(born, today).getYears()` counts whole years correctly, including whether this year's birthday has happened yet.
`born.withYear(year)` moves the birthday into another year and turns 29 February into 28 February when needed. If this year's has passed, use next year's.
